subject: data values from read.beast not matching those in FigTree + Tracer

messages.author: eb0788b8c1359cca
messages.subject: data values from read.beast not matching those in FigTree + Tracer
parts:
Hello All, 

I am trying to extract ages ( and other stats, like rates ) for all the internal nodes for my BEAST tree. However when I look for "height" values for my tree using mytree@data$height, the values that I get for the internal nodes are very different from the height values that I see in Figure and Tracer(using log file) are very different. I used "geom_text2(aes(subset=!isTip, label=node)" to label the inner nodes on my tree, then check their values (using read.beast) and compare them with those on FigTree. 
I have also checked values for length and rate parameters and they don't match as well.

I am not sure what am I doing wrong? I would really appreciate any help. 

I am not able to attache the log file here because (i assume) its very big in size. 

Thank you so much!
